acceptanceCriteria: An empty handle refuses with invalid-handle and a repeated --expand refuses as an argument error, both tested; an empty blob expands with line_end 0 documented or fixed.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent review of PR #85 (V1-0023, evidence summary views). Findings 4 and 5 of the PR #85 review.
title: context: `--expand ""` reports `--task required` and a repeated `--expand` silently takes the last value
